prompt.en: Which province does Discover Canada call the birthplace of Confederation?
prompt.fr: Quelle province Découvrir le Canada appelle-t-il le berceau de la Confédération?

explanation.en: The guide gives Prince Edward Island the name birthplace of Confederation.
explanation.fr: Le guide donne à l'Île-du-Prince-Édouard le nom de berceau de la Confédération.

source.quote: P.E.I. is the birthplace of Confederation

verification.evidence: Prince Edward Island (P.E.I.) is the smallest province, known for its beaches, red soil and agriculture, especially potatoes. P.E.I. is the birthplace of Confederation
